test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a college, the Art room, the Library, the Gym, the Labs, the storerooms, the staffrooms and the Classrooms are there on seven different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7. No other floors are there below the Library, and the Library is immediately below the Gym. Only two floors are there between the Gym and the Classrooms. Both the Labs and the Staffrooms are on even numbered floors. Only three floors are there between the storerooms and the Art room. The Storerooms are immediately below the Labs. Which of the following is/are there on floor number 4?
solution:
**Given:**

 the Art room, the Library, the Gym, the Labs, the storerooms, the staffrooms and the Classrooms are there on seven different floors of the same building

**Solution:**

 
• No other floors are there below the Library, This means library is at floor 1:

 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4ed6dd59bea4696fd075b5224903edc7cf4f010b926f4c0761ea2469a8763bf.png] 
 
 
 
• ​The Library is immediately below the Gym .This means Gym is at floor 6.
 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/826b6140e3c38a767338d863c0761d26138cc35318db1fea68a0190b3625a0a9.png] 
 
 
 
• Only two floors are there between the Gym and the Classrooms.
 
 
• ​Two possibilities are there either classroom is below or above gym. There is no space below gym so classroom must two floor above Gym . Hence classroom is at 5th floor.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80729e42e21389e46b012c45f6b8876ebc6b19423be497c0cd88affc82f10148.png] 
 
 
 
• ​Both the Labs and the Staffrooms are on even numbered floors.
 
 
• ​There are two vacent even number floors i.e 4 and 6 . There are two possible cases.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37f41c430bb73c05024b3085ff3b2b5814c5f522828ad2304461dbb2f5dd2931.png] ​
 
 
 
• Only three floors are there between the storerooms and the Art room. ​
 
 
• There are further two cases possible.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3df2a077ee550f841964e8d2b28b8556afa9b9062987c124d11a02b5fec84aaf.png] ​
 
 
 
• The Storerooms are immediately below the Labs. ​
 
 
• Case 2 follows this condition so the correct arrangement is:
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf735f7d57436ca876bf7ed98f0c89b461181eba3b5bcfed944b8e239a19b387.png] ​
 
 

Labs is at 4th floor.

**Hence , the correct answer is 'Option 4' .**
